note: Files this fork deletes that upstream still owns. Every one is a modify/delete conflict on the next sync, so each is asserted here rather than rediscovered: the resolver prints the entry and can apply it. LOCAL-PATCHES.md and local/sync/convergence-ledger.md stay the evidence; this file is the machine-readable claim. Generated from `git diff <base>..HEAD --diff-filter=D`, NOT from the log: a merge resolution can delete a file without a commit of its own, which is how agent-dashboard-open-mode.ts was missed the first time. A path listed as deleted must be absent at HEAD and present at upstream/main, and conflicts.mjs reports a stale entry on read.

statuses.expected-deletion: settled: the deletion is the fork's answer and a sync re-applies it
statuses.pending-decision: not settled: the deletion exists but nobody has chosen between restoring and keeping it
statuses.restore: settled the other way: the file comes back and a sync must not re-delete it

The fork delivers the dashboard as a full-page view (#44), which is the only delivery it exposes. Upstream's drawer and sidebar host need AppState.agentDashboardDrawerOpen, which the fork removed, and upstream's newer AgentKanbanBoard props. Restoring them re-adds a second live implementation of the same surface.

The fork's live page view is built on that same board, so restoring this means either two live dashboard implementations or changing the shipped view.
